Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for electronic monitoring for all level 2 and level 3 sex offenders.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to monitoring of sex offenders; adding new sectionsto chapter 9.94A RCW; adding new sections to chapter 13.40 RCW;providing an effective date; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9.94A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Every adult who has been convicted of any sex offense, and whois determined by the end of the sentence review committee process to bea level 2 or level 3 offender, shall wear an electronic home monitoringdevice at all times he or she is not in total confinement. If theperson lacks a fixed residence, he or she shall report to thedepartment of corrections every twentyfour hours. To the extent thatelectronic monitoring devices that employ global positioning systemtechnology are available, such devices shall be utilized. (2) The offender shall pay the cost of electronic home monitoringor the use of alternate monitoring devices. The department ofcorrections shall determine the cost. If the offender is indigent, thedepartment shall waive the cost. p. 1 SB 5205 (3) An offender may petition the superior court to be relieved ofthe duty established under subsection (1) of this section. The courtshall consider the nature of the offense, the criminal and relevantnoncriminal behavior of the petitioner both before and afteradjudication, and may consider other factors. (4) This section shall apply to all offenders released from totalconfinement after the effective date of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9.94A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The secretary of the department of corrections shall notify all sexoffenders currently under supervision in the community of therequirement to wear electronic monitoring devices commencing July 1,2003.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 13.40 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Every juvenile who has been convicted of any sex offense, andwho is determined by the end of the sentence review committee processto be a level 2 or level 3 offender, shall wear an electronic homemonitoring device at all times he or she is not in total confinement.If the person lacks a fixed residence, he or she shall report to thedepartment of corrections every twentyfour hours. To the extent thatelectronic monitoring devices that employ global positioning systemtechnology are available, such devices shall be utilized. (2) The offender shall pay the cost of electronic home monitoringor the use of alternate monitoring devices. The department ofcorrections shall determine the cost. If the offender is indigent, thedepartment shall waive the cost. (3) An offender may petition the superior court to be relieved ofthe duty established under subsection 1 of this section. The courtshall consider the nature of the offense, the criminal and relevantnoncriminal behavior of the petitioner both before and afteradjudication, and may consider other factors. (4) This section shall apply to all offenders released from totalconfinement after the effective date of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 13.40 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The secretary of the department of social and health services shallnotify all sex offenders currently under supervision in the communityof the requirement to wear electronic monitoring devices commencingJuly 1, 2003.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectJuly 1, 2003.
